idea: Symmetry-constrained continuous search: impose mirror or 180°-rotational symmetry (with an odd central square when n is odd). This halves the variables in the penalty/SLSQP optimisation of rotated squares and lets many more restarts fit in 60 s, exploring structures such as a central tilted square surrounded by symmetric axis-aligned rings.
